text: Two decisions from the last critique: (1) Recognise a job's landing exactly as the gate's closing_jobs (crates/athena-gate/src/invariant.rs, around lines 218-252) does: the commit adds any one of the job's closing files and the job's outcome in that commit's tree is landed, so a blocked job later landed through outcome-landed.json is a job_landing; reuse that function rather than a new rule, and test the blocked-then-landed shape. (2) operator/ is already an owner path in this repository: operator/.gitattributes holds '* athena-exclude', and attrs.rs evaluates attributes with git check-attr --source=<commit>, which honours nested files, so a lease commit under operator/ leaves the fingerprint unchanged and is records_only. Make the realistic fixture mirror that with a nested operator/.gitattributes, and say so in the test's doc comment.
